identity: This deck does not need to connect to win. Blood Artist and The Meathook Massacre turn every creature death into life loss, free sacrifice outlets keep the stream running, and undying bodies mean most of those deaths cost no cards at all. Emerge is folded into the same engine rather than bolted on top: emerge's sacrifice is part of the spell's cost, so casting Abundant Maw is simultaneously a drain trigger, a card, and a 6/4 that drains three more on the way down. Ghoultree is the bridge between the two halves — cast cheap off a graveyard the deck fills by killing its own creatures, and worth mana value 8 when eaten, which turns Abundant Maw into a one-mana spell.

restrictions.extra_build_constraint: At most 5 rare/mythic cards total across mainboard + sideboard; basic lands unlimited and exempt

mainboard.name: Blood Artist
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever this creature or another creature dies, target player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

mainboard.name: The Meathook Massacre
mainboard.oracle_text:
When The Meathook Massacre enters, each creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.
Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life.
Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, you gain 1 life.

mainboard.name: Falkenrath Torturer
mainboard.oracle_text: Sacrifice a creature: This creature gains flying until end of turn. If the sacrificed creature was a Human, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

mainboard.name: Butcher Ghoul
mainboard.oracle_text: Undying (When this creature dies, if it had no +1/+1 counters on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.)
mainboard.role: Undying fodder — two deaths from one card

mainboard.name: Young Wolf
mainboard.oracle_text: Undying (When this creature dies, if it had no +1/+1 counters on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.)
mainboard.role: Undying fodder — two deaths from one card

mainboard.name: Morbid Opportunist
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever one or more other creatures die, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
mainboard.role: Death payoff — converts the stream into cards

mainboard.name: Ghoultree
mainboard.oracle_text: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature card in your graveyard.
mainboard.role: Fodder — mana-value-8 body cast for 2-4 / 10-10 beater

mainboard.name: Abundant Maw
mainboard.oracle_text:
Emerge {6}{B} (You may cast this spell by sacrificing a creature and paying the emerge cost reduced by that creature's mana value.)
When you cast this spell, target opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.

mainboard.name: It of the Horrid Swarm
mainboard.oracle_text:
Emerge {6}{G} (You may cast this spell by sacrificing a creature and paying the emerge cost reduced by that creature's mana value.)
When you cast this spell, create two 1/1 green Insect creature tokens.
mainboard.role: Emerge payoff — two Insect tokens = two more drain triggers; single {G} off a Ghoultree

mainboard.name: Decimator of the Provinces
mainboard.oracle_text:
Emerge {6}{G}{G}{G} (You may cast this spell by sacrificing a creature and paying the emerge cost reduced by that creature's mana value.)
When you cast this spell, creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain trample until end of turn.
Trample, haste
mainboard.role: Emerge payoff — converts a wide board into lethal

mainboard.name: Tragic Slip
mainboard.oracle_text:
Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
Morbid — That creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead if a creature died this turn.
mainboard.role: Interaction — morbid removal, always live here

mainboard.name: Infernal Grasp
mainboard.oracle_text: Destroy target creature. You lose 2 life.

mainboard.name: Eaten Alive
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay {3}{B}.
Exile target creature or planeswalker.
mainboard.role: Interaction — exile removal, sacrifice as cost

mainboard.name: Maelstrom Pulse
mainboard.oracle_text: Destroy target nonland permanent and all other permanents with the same name as that permanent.
mainboard.role: Interaction — the only artifact/enchantment answer in these colours

mainboard.name: Deathcap Glade
mainboard.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped unless you control two or more other lands.
{T}: Add {B} or {G}.
mainboard.role: Land — BG dual, untapped with two other lands

mainboard.name: Haunted Mire
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {B} or {G}.)
This land enters tapped.

sideboard.name: Sever the Bloodline
sideboard.oracle_text:
Exile target creature and all other creatures with the same name as that creature.
Flashback {5}{B}{B} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
sideboard.when_to_board: vs token and duplicate-heavy decks, and vs recursive threats — exile-by-name answers a swarm, and exile beats anything that returns from the graveyard

sideboard.name: Deadly Allure
sideboard.oracle_text:
Target creature gains deathtouch until end of turn and must be blocked this turn if able.
Flashback {G} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
sideboard.when_to_board: vs single large threats — deathtouch plus 'must be blocked this turn if able' forces the trade, and the {G} flashback makes it two answers in one card

sideboard.name: Ambush Viper
sideboard.when_to_board: vs aggressive creature decks — flash deathtouch at two mana trades with anything, and the body is drain fuel afterwards

sideboard.name: Skirsdag High Priest
sideboard.oracle_text: Morbid — {T}, Tap two untapped creatures you control: Create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying. Activate only if a creature died this turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs grindy or controlling decks — morbid 'Create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying' is live every turn in a deck that kills its own creatures, and it converts a stalled board into a clock

sideboard.name: Geistcatcher's Rig
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may have it deal 4 damage to target creature with flying.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs decks with FLIERS specifically — 'deal 4 damage to target creature with flying'. Stated precisely: the cube's 58-card 'evasion' class also contains equipment, auras, menace and trample, none of which this answers, so the true denominator is materially smaller than 58. It is also a colourless mana-value-6 emerge battery: sacrificed to Abundant Maw it erases the full {6} generic exactly as a Ghoultree does.

sideboard.name: Morkrut Banshee
sideboard.oracle_text: Morbid — When this creature enters, if a creature died this turn, target creature gets -4/-4 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs creature decks — morbid 'target creature gets -4/-4' is live off any Falkenrath Torturer activation, and at mana value 5 it is the deck's second-largest emerge payment after Ghoultree

sideboard.name: Village Rites
sideboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Draw two cards.
sideboard.role: Card draw off the sacrifice engine
sideboard.when_to_board: vs grindy and attrition decks — 'sacrifice a creature. Draw two cards' at instant speed, where the sacrifice is itself a Blood Artist trigger and an undying body comes straight back; it is the direct answer to the mainboard's thin card draw

identity_es: Este mazo no necesita conectar para ganar. Blood Artist y The Meathook Massacre convierten cada muerte de criatura en pérdida de vida, los medios de sacrificio gratuitos mantienen el flujo, y los cuerpos con undying hacen que la mayoría de esas muertes no cuesten carta alguna. El emerge está integrado en el mismo motor en vez de atornillado encima: el sacrificio del emerge es parte del coste del hechizo, así que lanzar Abundant Maw es a la vez un disparo de drenaje, una carta y un 6/4 que drena tres más al caer. Ghoultree es el puente entre ambas mitades: se lanza barato desde un cementerio que el mazo llena matando a sus propias criaturas, y vale valor de maná 8 cuando se lo comen, lo que convierte a Abundant Maw en un hechizo de un maná.
